mission.explanation: The periapsis of the true orbit at SECO is below the minimum, or the upper stage reached the surface.

model_validity: Exploratory planar 3-DOF point-mass model; the vehicles are not real vehicles and nothing is validated against flight data. Spherical non-rotating Earth with inverse-square gravity, isothermal exponential atmosphere, constant drag coefficient, no winds, no attitude dynamics, no structural loads, no engine transients, no boostback or landing burn of the booster.
notes: Small launcher (exploratory): exploratory, not a real vehicle; order-of-magnitude values only.

Planar 3-DOF point mass over a spherical, non-rotating Earth with inverse-square gravity and an isothermal exponential atmosphere; constant drag coefficient; no winds, attitude dynamics, structural loads or engine transients.
After separation the booster and the upper stage are integrated independently from the same state. The booster is ballistic to impact: no boostback or landing burn is modelled.
The flight software sees only a noisy navigation solution and the nominal vehicle; every requirement is judged on the true state. Mission result and safety invariants are reported separately.
Event order: tick, then entity (stack, booster, upper), then source (truth, controller, verifier), then emission order.
